name: Gurpreet WebTranslator AI
author: Gurpreet Singh

sections.description:
Gurpreet WebTranslator AI connects your WordPress site to the world’s most advanced Neural Machine Translation engine. Forget the tedious process of manually translating posts one by one—our new version introduces Auto Full Website Translation.

With just one click, your entire website, including WooCommerce products, pages, and blog posts, is instantly available in over 50+ languages.

Unlike standard auto-translators that merely swap text on the fly using JavaScript (which search engines often miss), Gurpreet WebTranslator AI provides incredibly fast, cached translations with clean, native URL slugs (e.g., /fr/about-us). This is the gold standard for international SEO.

Why choose Gurpreet WebTranslator AI?

  • 🤖 Fully Automatic “Hands-Off” Translation: Setup takes less than 2 minutes via our intelligent Setup Wizard. Just pick your languages, click save, and your entire website is instantly multilingual!
  • 🚀 True SEO Superpower: We create real, indexable URLs (e.g., your-site.com/es/shop), ensuring Google and other search engines index your content in every language. This drives massive organic global traffic.
  • ⚡ Blazing Fast AI Caching: Translated pages are intelligently cached. When a user visits a translated page, it loads instantly, providing a seamless and lightning-fast user experience.
  • 🎨 Layout & Design Safe: Our AI engine understands WordPress Blocks (Gutenberg), Shortcodes, and complex HTML structures. It perfectly translates the text while keeping your design, images, and forms completely intact.
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Native: Fully translates complex products, descriptions, and checkout flows while intelligently preserving critical data like Price, SKU, and Stock.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Setup Wizard: Get your site translated in minutes with our beautiful, guided setup process.
  • Automatic Language Switcher: A sleek, customizable floating language switcher is automatically added to your site.
  • Fail-Proof AI Engine: Our backend utilizes a robust multi-model fallback system to guarantee 100% translation uptime, even during massive traffic spikes.
  • Search Engine Optimized: Clean URL slugs for every language version boost your site’s global visibility.
  • Smart Context Awareness: Skips code blocks, shortcodes, and technical metadata to prevent site errors.
  • 50+ Languages Supported: Instantly translate into Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and dozens more.

Privacy & 3rd Party Service Disclosure
This plugin relies on a 3rd party SaaS service (WebTranslator AI) to process translations securely and rapidly.

  • Your content is sent to our servers (https://webtranslator-ai.onrender.com) strictly for processing via our external AI translation service.
  • We do NOT train public AI models on your data. Your intellectual property remains 100% private and secure.
  • An API Key is required to use this service. You can obtain a free key by signing up at WebTranslator AI Website.
  • Terms of Service: https://webtranslator-ai.onrender.com/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://webtranslator-ai.onrender.com/privacy.html

Support & Documentation

Need help setting up? Found a bug?
* Help Center: View Documentation & Guides
* Community: Feel free to open a thread in the WordPress.org support tab.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gurpreet-webtranslator-ai directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. The intelligent Setup Wizard will automatically launch to guide you.
  4. Enter your API Key (Get one for free from WebTranslator AI).
  5. Select your default language and the languages you want to translate to.
  6. Click save—your entire website is now fully multilingual and ready to dominate global search engines!
sections.faq:
Is this free?

The plugin allows a generous number of free translations per month. For massive websites or enterprise volume, a premium plan is available via the external dashboard.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! It translates product details flawlessly while preserving pricing, stock, and variations.

How does the automatic translation work?

When a user clicks a language on the switcher (e.g., Spanish), the plugin translates the page on-the-fly and then securely caches it. The next time anyone visits that Spanish page, it loads instantly from the cache!

Can I clear the translation cache?

Yes, you can manage and clear your translation cache directly from the plugin’s beautifully designed dashboard.

Is the translation SEO friendly?

Absolutely. Our plugin uses sub-directory URL structures (e.g., /fr/) which are highly recommended by Google for international SEO, unlike JavaScript-based switchers that search engines ignore.

Does it slow down my website?

No! The translation process happens in the background. Once a page is translated, it is served from an ultra-fast local cache, ensuring maximum speed for your visitors.

Do I need an API Key?

Yes. To process translations securely via our high-speed neural engine, you need to connect the plugin using an API key obtained from your WebTranslator AI dashboard.
